pages.title: The Divine Chariot
pages.text: $(bold)Cult of Azazel's god: the Divine Chariot Azazel's scythe, spear and shield, its armour and its trophies. Needs Warrior as well.$(br2)$(thing)Nether Age$(n), ring 8.$(br)$(thing)22 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Veteran and Warrior.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill Azazel$(n)$(br2)Pays 9 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
